blocks.text: Your day as a logistics planner involves constant adjustments. You monitor shipping route optimization software, track carrier performance, and respond to urgent emails. These tasks require focus. When you jump between browser tabs and desktop apps, you lose momentum. Lazur acts as a bridge between your intent and your Mac apps.

Many planners rely on Excel for data analysis. You might spend hours comparing carrier rates or verifying delivery windows. If you need to know how to add a filter to a range in Google Sheets, you do not need to search through menus. Just hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur. It points at the correct menu path on your screen.

Email is often the biggest bottleneck for logistics teams. You receive updates on delays, compliance documents, and customer requests. Managing this flow takes a large portion of your day. You can use Lazur to dictate responses when you are away from your keyboard or need to draft a quick reply. Hold the fn key to start dictation in any app, including Gmail or Slack.
Shipping route optimization tools on Mac

Specialized software for shipping route optimization often has complex interfaces. Whether you use a web-based TMS or a desktop application, the layout can be dense. If you get lost in a new interface, ask Lazur where a specific setting is. It will circle the button or menu item you need. This saves you from hunting through help documentation.

Manual data entry is a common source of error in logistics. You might copy data from a PDF report into a spreadsheet. Lazur helps you stay focused by providing quick summaries of your research. If you are researching new carriers, let Lazur search for information in its own Chrome tabs. It returns with a summary report so you do not have to switch context constantly.

Excel remains a staple for supply chain modeling. You might need to calculate percentage change in Excel for a quarterly review. Instead of remembering the exact formula or menu sequence, ask Lazur to guide you. It will walk you through the steps one click at a time, waiting for you to finish each action.

blocks.text: As a professional, you handle sensitive data. Lazur respects your privacy. It only listens and looks at your screen while you hold the shortcut keys. Audio and screenshots are sent to AI providers to answer your request and are not stored. Your data is never used to train AI models. Always follow your employer's rules regarding client or sensitive information.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in my logistics software?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not operate other apps for you. It points at buttons and guides you, but you perform the clicks.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on Windows?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is currently built only for macOS on Apple silicon and Intel chips.

faq.question: How do I start a request with Lazur?
faq.answer: Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything on your screen, or hold fn to dictate text.
